long_description:
Healthcare is a right, not a commodity.

Join the Boston South Asian Coalition for our Public Health Forum

November 15, Sunday

3–6 PM

📍 Community Church Boston,

565 Boylston Street, Boston (Copley Square T stop)

The panel will discuss why growing privatization is harming public health across borders, and why Medicare for All and collective action are the need of the hour.

From FDA, CDC, and HHS cuts to the privatization of care in the US and India, marginalized communities are paying the price. Nurses face understaffing and corporate takeovers, and families face crushing medical debt. Medicare for All is the path forward. Let’s talk about how we fight back together.

🎤 Speakers

Dr. Varuna Srinivasan

@myfluidhealth Physician-turned Public Health Educator

Heather Clark, Co-Founder, South Shore Medicare for All

Katie Murphy, RN, President, Massachusetts Nurses Association
